TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Multi-pair button location for your Bluetooth speaker
arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

For your Portable Bluetooth Speaker (SKU-1016):

The multi-pair button is usually labeled "M" or has a double Bluetooth icon. It's typically a separate button on the side or back, not the main power button.

Check:
1. Look for a small button with "M" or two overlapping Bluetooth symbols
2. Try pressing the Bluetooth button twice quickly
3. If you still can't find it, the manual has diagrams showing all button locations

I've also included a link to the digital manual here: [TechMart.com/speaker-SKU-1016-manual]

Let me know if you need further help!

Best,
TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Multi-device pairing instructions for your Bluetooth speaker
arguments.body:
Hi there,

As we discussed, here are the steps for multi-device pairing on your Bluetooth speaker:

1. Press and hold the "M" button on the back for 3 seconds until the LED flashes
2. Pair your first device through Bluetooth settings
3. Repeat step 1, then pair your second device
4. To switch between devices, press the "M" button quickly

If you have any issues getting this to work, please reply to this email and I'll be happy to help further.

Best regards,
TechMart Support
